_doc: Denver image catalogue: the single record of every appliance render, job / service photo and brand logo the pages use.
Exports are written by python3 tools/export-denver-images.py (no EXIF / XMP / ICC). Originals are never changed or deleted.
photos[].status: use = placed on pages; unused = kept, not placed; retired = must not appear on any page (see note).
No alt text or caption names a city: the place of each job is not recorded, so photos are never presented as Denver jobs.
renders: subject renders matched by looking at each image, not by file name. logos: one per Denver brand page; brands without an official file keep a text pill.
Source carries EXIF/XMP from 'Express Repair New York' with GPS coordinates; the export is written without any metadata.
